Which shortwave radio stations are on air now?

As of Friday, October 9, 2026, 09:13 UTC, 173 shortwave stations are scheduled to be on the air, including 4DX Radio, Alcaravan Radio, Auckland Radio, BBC DIGITAL. The table at the top of this page lists them with frequency, language and target area.

How many shortwave radio stations are there?

The A-26 schedule used by ShortwaveHQ lists 316 stations: 279 international and domestic broadcasters, 13 time-signal stations, 11 numbers stations and 13 pirate or free-radio stations. Counts change each season as broadcasters start and stop services.

Which shortwave stations have the most broadcasts?

By number of scheduled broadcasts in the A-26 schedule, the busiest international stations are China Radio International, Sound of Hope, BBC, Voice of Korea, China National Radio 1. Open any station page for its full list of frequencies and UTC times.

How do I find a shortwave station's schedule and frequency?

Open any station page from the A–Z list. Each page shows that station's frequencies, broadcast times in UTC, languages and target areas from the A-26 schedule.

Can I listen to these stations without a radio?

Yes. Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. See the Listen Online page for links and tuning steps.
